name: Agency Setup
description: One read-back-verified agency profile and, only when exactly selected, a no-launch finance setup handoff.
audience: Solo operators and small agencies setting up reusable agent context.
problem: Agency operators need durable orientation without creating a separate agency-management system.
outcome: One read-back-verified agency profile and, only when exactly selected, a no-launch finance setup handoff.
operatorPath: Supply an agency name and short context, plus optional navigation reference and explicit guidance.
Review the saved profile and separately decide whether to set up exact finance workflows.
agentPath: Inspect current-project agency profiles and resolve one existing or stable new profile reference from supplied identity before strict run validation.
Merge supplied facts with permitted existing optional context, persist one profile, and read it back.
Return a setup_existing finance handoff only for exact selected workflow keys; do not launch it.
recovery: If profile identity conflicts or more than one current profile exists, stop for operator direction rather than overwriting or creating another profile.
safeStoppingPoints: Stop after agency context is verified. Finance setup is a separate optional handoff and is never started implicitly.
prerequisites: A currently bound StackOS project and operator-supplied agency identity.
proof: and a bounded optional finance handoff.
whenToUse: A new agency workspace needs minimal durable context for future agents.
An existing agency profile needs a reviewed update under its stable reference.

stages.title: Inventory Existing Agency Setup
stages.summary: Inspect bounded current-project agency-profile context and resolve one stable identity.

stages.title: Resolve Supplied Agency Facts
stages.summary: Produce the complete write payload by merging supplied facts with permitted existing optional context.

stages.title: Persist Agency Profile
stages.summary: Upsert the resolved complete profile under its stable external id.

stages.title: Read Back And Hand Off
stages.summary: Verify the saved profile and return an optional no-launch finance setup handoff.
